title: Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 1)
meaning: The PCM detected an open or short circuit in the Bank 1 Intake VVT/VCT solenoid control circuit.
inspectionSteps: Check VVT solenoid connector for oil contamination.
Measure solenoid internal coil resistance (typically 6-12 ohms).
Inspect engine oil level and viscosity.
verifiedFixes: Clean or replace VVT oil control filter screen
Fresh engine oil and filter change

title: Mass Air Flow (MAF) Circuit Range/Performance
meaning: The MAF sensor output voltage or frequency does not match calculated airflow based on engine RPM and throttle position.
inspectionSteps: Inspect intake ductwork for leaks downstream of MAF.
Check air filter condition.
Clean MAF sensing wire with dedicated cleaner.
verifiedFixes: Clean MAF sensor with MAF cleaner spray

title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor 1 Circuit High
meaning: IAT sensor voltage reading is stuck high (typically indicates open circuit or disconnected sensor, reading -40°).
inspectionSteps: Verify IAT/MAF connector is firmly plugged in.
Check wiring harness for chafing or broken wires.
Measure IAT sensor thermistor resistance.

title: Coolant Temp Below Thermostat Regulating Temp
meaning: Engine takes abnormally long to reach closed-loop operating temperature (typically 180°F / 82°C).
symptoms: Cabin heater blows lukewarm air in winter
inspectionSteps: Check upper radiator hose warmth immediately after cold start.
Inspect coolant level in expansion tank.
Verify ECT live telemetry reading.

title: System Too Lean (Bank 1)
meaning: ECU detects excess unmetered oxygen; positive fuel trim is maxed out (+20% to +25%).
inspectionSteps: Inspect intake bellows accordion boot for cracks.
Inspect PCV vacuum hoses.
Clean MAF sensor wire.
Check fuel rail pressure under load.
verifiedFixes: Replace cracked intake air boot or PCV hose
Replace failing Upstream O2 / A/F sensor

title: System Too Rich (Bank 1)
meaning: ECU detects excess unburnt fuel; negative fuel trim is maxed out (-20% to -25%).
inspectionSteps: Sniff oil dipstick for fuel dilution.
Check EVAP purge valve for vacuum leak.
Inspect air filter.
Check for leaking fuel injector.

title: Random / Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
meaning: Crankshaft speed fluctuations indicate incomplete combustion across multiple cylinders.
symptoms: Flashing Check Engine Light (Catalyst damage risk)
inspectionSteps: Inspect spark plugs for wear or fouling.
Check ignition coil boots for oil soaking or carbon tracking.
Inspect intake manifold for vacuum leaks.
verifiedFixes: Replace spark plugs and ignition coils

title: Cylinder 1 Misfire Detected
meaning: Crankshaft position sensor detected combustion failure specifically on Cylinder 1.
symptoms: Engine shudder on idle and load
inspectionSteps: Swap Ignition Coil #1 with Coil #2 to see if misfire follows.
Inspect Spark Plug #1 electrode and gap.
Perform compression test on Cylinder 1.

title: Cylinder 2 Misfire Detected
meaning: Crankshaft position sensor detected combustion failure specifically on Cylinder 2.
symptoms: Engine shudder on idle and load
inspectionSteps: Swap Ignition Coil #2 with Coil #1.
Inspect Spark Plug #2.
Inspect fuel injector harness.

title: Cylinder 3 Misfire Detected
meaning: Crankshaft position sensor detected combustion failure specifically on Cylinder 3.
symptoms: Engine shudder on idle and load
inspectionSteps: Swap Ignition Coil #3 with Coil #1.
Inspect Spark Plug #3.

title: Cylinder 4 Misfire Detected
meaning: Crankshaft position sensor detected combustion failure specifically on Cylinder 4.
symptoms: Engine shudder on idle and load
inspectionSteps: Swap Ignition Coil #4 with Coil #1.
Inspect Spark Plug #4.

title: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
meaning: Downstream oxygen sensor waveform mirrors upstream sensor, indicating catalytic converter oxygen storage loss.
symptoms: Rotten egg / sulfur smell from exhaust
inspectionSteps: Confirm no exhaust manifold leaks before converter.
Verify upstream and downstream O2 sensor response in live data.
Check for misfire history.

title: EVAP System Small Leak Detected (.040")
meaning: The fuel tank evaporative control system cannot hold vacuum during self-test due to a small pinhole leak.
symptoms: Faint fuel smell near rear quarter panel
inspectionSteps: Inspect gas cap rubber O-ring seal for dry rot or dirt.
Inspect EVAP vent and purge lines under chassis.
Perform smoke test on EVAP system.
verifiedFixes: Clean or replace gas cap (OEM replacement)
Replace cracked EVAP canister vapor line
Replace sticking EVAP vent solenoid valve

title: EVAP System Gross Leak Detected
meaning: EVAP system detected large loss of tank vacuum, usually indicating loose or missing gas cap.
symptoms: Check Gas Cap warning light illuminated
inspectionSteps: Check if gas cap is securely tightened or missing.
Inspect filler neck for rust or physical dents.
Check EVAP purge line disconnects.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor (VSS) Malfunction
meaning: The PCM lost signal from the Vehicle Speed Sensor or wheel speed input.
inspectionSteps: Check VSS sensor connector and wiring harness.
Verify wheel speed sensor signals in live telemetry.
Inspect sensor reluctor ring teeth.
verifiedFixes: Clean metallic debris from wheel speed sensor

title: Lost Communication with ECM / PCM 'A'
meaning: Modules on the CAN bus stopped receiving periodic status heartbeat broadcasts from Engine Control Module.
symptoms: Multiple warning lights (ABS, Traction, CEL, Trans)
inspectionSteps: Measure 12V battery voltage under load.
Inspect PCM ground straps in engine bay.
Inspect CAN high and low bus wiring resistance (should be 60 ohms).
verifiedFixes: Clean/tighten battery terminals and main chassis ground straps
Repair broken CAN bus twisted pair wiring

title: Lost Communication with Transmission Control Module (TCM)
meaning: ECM and other modules lost communication with the TCM over High-Speed CAN.
symptoms: Transmission stuck in limp home gear (usually 3rd)
Check Engine and AT lights on
inspectionSteps: Check TCM fuse in engine bay fuse box.
Inspect TCM wiring harness connector for corrosion.
Verify battery voltage.
verifiedFixes: Clean corroded TCM wiring plug pins

title: Lost Communication with Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) Module
meaning: ECM or BCM failed to receive expected CAN communication packets from ABS/ESP module.
symptoms: ABS and Traction Control lights illuminated
inspectionSteps: Inspect ABS module main multi-pin plug for water intrusion.
Check ABS fuse in power distribution box.
Test ground wire to ABS pump.
verifiedFixes: Clean and reseat ABS module connector
